findings.finding: Progress panel dumps raw JSON — developer dashboard pattern shown to learners.
No lesson content body / worked example surface in companion shell — only pack IDs.
Role + a11y controls present but completion/reward feedback is minimal.
Visual hierarchy is flat four-equal-panels; next action not dominant.
Motivated student may not understand why a pack matters or see a visible lab result quickly.
Portfolio export exists, but in-shell progress presentation is dry/repetitive JSON.
Tutor note is a static sentence — does not feel like coaching.
